name: Open rooms are judged more beautiful than enclosed rooms
claim: In an fMRI study, people judged open rooms more beautiful and more often chose to leave enclosed rooms.
caveat: Image stimuli in a scanner; we read the findings from summaries of the abstract, and the sample size and ceiling values are not confirmed.

sources.title: Vartanian et al. 2015, Architectural design and the brain: ceiling height and perceived enclosure, Journal of Environmental Psychology 41
